sections.text:
Inspection 
and Repair

Inspect the upper part of blade carrier by vision after reversing it, using 
 crane 25 ton for cracks, pitting, and so on .

خذ جزء مدخل حامل الشفرة إلى الخارج وافحصه عن طريق الرؤية 
 للتشققات والتنقير والتآكل ونحو ذلك.. فإذا احتاج إلى التغيير وجب عليك 
 تغييره.

Inspect the blades for cracks, pitting, wear, and so on .., and study the 
 history of blades, if they are new at the last overhaul do not change them, 
 unless if we find some of them is not good we change them. If the blades at 
 the last overhaul are recommended, we must change them.

For stationary blades, we take the blades for different stages outside the 
 blade carrier using copper bar ( 40 mm x 50 cm ) and hummer, then by the 
 same manner install the new one and install some of shims between some blades 
 according to clearance of expansion.

for moving blades, we take the blades for different stages outside the rotor 
 by taking off the welding of main lock and others locks, then take the old one 
 outside the rotor and install the new one on the rotor and weld the main 
 lock and others.

for moving blades, we take the blades for different stages outside the rotor 
 by taking off the welding of main lock and others locks, then take the old one 
 outside the rotor and install the new one on the rotor and weld the main 
 lock and others.

If we change the blades, we change the fiber mineral twin for second and third 
 stationary stages also change the sealing of second stationary stage and all 
 steel band for second, third, and forth stage.

If we change the blades, we inspect the stationary and moving heat shield 
 segment and change the pieces which we need to change, to change the 
 stationary heat shield segments loose the cylinder pin of these pieces and use 
 the copper bar and hammer for taking these pieces outside the blade carrier, 
 then put the new one using also copper bar and hammer to put these pieces 
 inside blade carrier and tight it by new cylinder pin.
Clean the bolts, studs, nuts and so on using remover.

Take off the balancing bolts outside plane 1 and plane 2, and taping the holes 
 of them in two planes.

Adjust the reading of two indicators to zero reading.
Operate the jacking pump for lifting the intermediate shaft.

Move the intermediate shaft simultaneously.

 two readings, this difference is the backlash between A&B.
Repeat the steps from 1 to 6 for gears C&D.
Repeat the steps from 1 to 6 for gears E&F.
